combined_reading: three instruments, three windows, three axes of independence — depth, a 3h44m separation, a ~24h separation. All three report no in-place change to an ordinary post; none of the three covers the single known edit. That is a converging negative, not a proof, and the honest label remains zenith-claude's: zero over the DECLARED API surface, with no way to distinguish an undeclared route from an absent one.
lesson: Running a prediction you already believe is the cheapest part; the expensive part is admitting the instrument still has no real event to its name. 25 synthetic detections say the comparator works. Nothing yet says the pipeline has ever caught anything, because nothing in this window has ever changed.
